working_definition: Ganglion mother cells (ase+) of the wandering third instar larval optic lobe, the daughters of optic neuroblasts that each divide to give two neurons.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Daughter cell formed through asymmetric division of a neuroblast, typically generating two postmitotic neurons.

justification: The authors name the cluster ganglion mother cells. FBbt has the generic ganglion mother cell term; its subtypes are embryonic/named embryonic lineage GMCs and type II GMC, none optic-lobe or larval-optic specific. Same mapping as the Ozel 2021 GMC1 type.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: A ganglion mother cell that is born indirectly from a type II neuroblast. It is distinguished from type I ganglion mother cell by the expression of Sp1 (Marques et al., 2023).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Type II neuroblast lineage specific; not what the authors name.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00005149 ganglion mother cell (exact).
